trickyParts: The compaction write re-reads (version, xmin) of every folded row inside its transaction and drops the fold on any difference; an append above the fold point changes nothing folded, so a write during the fold no longer drops it (the plan's acceptance 3a expected a drop; it is correct to commit).

A room load hands ygo no bytes: LoadDoc puts the state on the roomLoad record and onLoadDocument decodes it before anything reads or observes the document, under the pending cap ygo sets before the hook (maxUpdateItems, validateUpdate's cap).

The sweep's period is the aligned hour across processes and restarts (duty_passes): a process restarted within an hour that a process already swept leaves the due documents to its queue (noted by loads and appends) or to the next hour.

The ygo fork was patched (dependency-ordered retry of deferred items) and released as v1.51.3-sami.6, then sami.7, by the fork's release session; upstream reached the same fix in v1.51.12 (reearth/ygo #296, #312), which the fork's base predates.
deviations: Acceptance 6's 1.25x condition (one row versus one row plus 15 young rows) is removed by the INFRA-514 architect's decision (2026-10-27T11:51Z, option A): each young row is a real update a load must integrate. The PR body records the young-row numbers, the profile and the drained-queue invariant.

D4 is revised by the INFRA-514 architect's decision (2026-10-28T10:39Z, option B): a room load decodes a single stored row once, in the load hook, and fails the room from that decode; plan.md version 2 records it. The 2.32x step before it stays in the PR body.

The plan's acceptance 3a expected a write during a held fold to make the compaction drop its result; under D1 an append above the fold point leaves every folded row unchanged, so the compaction commits; the tests check the write completes while the fold is held and the appended row stays as written.
compactIfIdle is removed: the room-close compaction passes wait = roomFailed(room) to compactRoom.
The sweep compacts what the queue's due rule (checkCompaction) calls due: the 15-minute age rule or 16 rows older than 2 minutes, a superset of D3's age rule alone.
The queue's first check of a noted room comes compactTail (2 minutes) after the note; no row a note adds can be due sooner.
